open_items: No endpoint status change and no new contract change this run (compared against cycle 1246, scanning cycles 1247-1249 in between: all twelve endpoints stayed healthy throughout).
ABS and ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped cosmetically again this cycle (same recurring pattern); verdict stayed ok, not an incident.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1249. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
137 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run (up from 136 at cycle 1246). Still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

main is still only through cycle 1168's PR. This run's own merge-to-main attempt is reported separately in the session output; if it also fails, this run's findings stay recorded on this branch and the next run's branch-scan will pick them up.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status. Not re-confirmed this run since no contract-only state occurred, but still believed true.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
